prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_time_estimate: Displays a dynamic progress bar and estimated time remaining on the waiting screen while pet assets are generated.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Your desktop companion is being prepared and will land on your screen shortly."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] new_desktop_pet_welcome_screen: Adds a new post-onboarding summary screen that highlights how to find, right-click, and toggle the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_welcome_overview"], "new_welcome_overview": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open controls, change settings, or hide it.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_split_layout: Changes the choose_path screen layout to a side-by-side split view highlighting ready-made pet vs custom photo upload options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Path", "hint": "Pick a ready-to-go companion or create a custom pet from your photos."}}
3: [finish, redesign] home_intro_centered_redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen into a clear centered view with explicit desktop controls instructions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Pet Adopted Successfully!", "body": "Look at your desktop to find your pet. Use right-click for options and interactions."}}
4: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_quality_tip: Adds a detailed tip on photo selection criteria directly on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit, front-facing photos of a single pet for the best custom rendering result."}}
5: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_session_status_notify: Enables a background status notification indicator during authentication so users know sign-in is actively working.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Authenticating your account securely. Please wait a moment."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] story_headline_clarity_boost: Updates the initial story screen text to set expectations about quick setup and instant desktop pet availability.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Bring Your Desktop to Life in 60 Seconds", "body": "Choose or build an interactive virtual companion that stays on your screen while you work."}}
7: [adoption, layout] upload_photos_grid_layout: Switches the photo upload screen to a grid layout for easier photo management and visual feedback.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Add Pet Photos"}}
8: [home, new_flow] new_waiting_interactive_tips_flow: Inserts an interactive tip screen during the waiting process so users can read pet control tips while generation completes.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_waiting_tips", "home_intro"], "new_waiting_tips": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Pet Tips", "body": "While your pet loads: Right-click for menu, drag to move around your screen, or double-click to play.", "layout": "checklist"}}
9: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_after_adoption_reorder: Moves the sign-in step after pet selection and customization so users invest in their pet before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Pet to Your Account", "body": "Sign in now to sync your new companion across your devices."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds progress bar and time estimate for a real wait during pet generation.
Adds a new welcome summary screen after home_intro, which is allowed inside onboarding.
Redesigns choose_path layout while maintaining both adoption and custom pet creation options.
Valid redesign of the home intro screen layout and copy.
Adds helpful photo quality guidance to the photo upload screen.
Adds authentication status notification indicator during sign-in.
Updates story text while successfully introducing the pet.
Valid grid layout redesign for photo upload screen.
Inserts a new interactive tip screen into the onboarding flow.
Reorders sign-in after adoption certificate, as explicitly permitted by rule 4.
